scope: Aggregated existing role evidence only. No new source audit or test execution was performed to produce this document.
credit_rules: Source intervals are merged only within the same repository path and exact Git blob SHA; different revisions are never combined into a fictitious full-file read.
Full source-text extent means explicit intervals cover an entire verified text blob. It does not prove exhaustive semantic correctness or native acceptance.
The any-documented-blob summary describes the 153 original paths at one or more recorded revisions. The baseline and tested-snapshot summaries separately show exact revision coverage.
Search matches, structural TOML/AST processing, hashes, authored-file metadata, and full delta reviews without final line intervals do not become source-body reading credit.
Automatic blob metadata and line counts used for aggregation do not themselves establish source-reading credit.
Missing source intervals mean no documented interval in these evidence files, not a claim that nobody ever looked at the file.
The unmaterialized PNG is inventoried only and receives no reading or visual-inspection credit.
The audit documentation being published after the tested code commit is excluded from its source inventory and test scope.
